highlights: Real 4K HDMI HDR Cable: UGREEN HDMI 4K Ultra HD Cable complies with standard HDMI 2.0, max supports UHD resolution up to 4K@60Hz (3840x2160p), also back compatible with 2K@144Hz/60Hz, 3840*2160@30Hz, 1080P@120Hz, 1080P@60Hz, 1280*720@60Hz. Expanded bandwidth of 18Gbps transmits video and audio without buffering, giving you the immersive visual and audio experience of gaming and streaming, easily enjoy the visual feast of high definition content.

Experience 4K@60Hz Stunning Visual: UGREEN 4K HDMI 2.0 Cable fully supports 4:4:4 Chroma, HDR/HDR 10, 1080P HD, UHD, and 1440p QHD high-quality image. The 4K HDMI HDR Lead features 3D effect, 48-Bit Deep Color and Mirror & Extend mode, also supports Full HD 16:9 monitor and ultra-wide 21:9 gaming monitor. The 4K HDMI UHD Cable is an ideal companion for home theaters, game centers and conference rooms.

HDMI ARC Cable With Ethernet: The 4K HDMI Male to Male Cable features ARC (Audio Return Channel)function to deliver audio directly from HDMI ARC enabled TV to a soundbar or AV receiver, allowing you to enjoy dolby atmos sound. Plus, the 18Gbps High Speed HDMI 2.0 Cable is Ethernet-enabled and makes it easy for multiple HDMI devices to share an Internet connection. The HDMI ARC Ethernet Lead simplifies the connections and saves lots of cables for you.

Enhanced Durability & Stability: Tangle-free braided jacket, anti-oxidation nickle-plated connectors plus reinforced wire joints significantly improve the durability and lifespan of this 4K HDMI ARC Dolby Atmos Cable. Tinned copper conductors and 4-Layer shielding provides excellent protection to signal and offer crystal clear picture and pure sound.

Universal Fit: The HDMI ARC Ethernet Cable supports devices of HDMI 2.1/2.0/1.4/1.3 Type A interfaces, like TV Stick, NS Switch, Switch OLED, Wii U, MacBook, laptop, PC, computer, game consoles(PS5/PS4/PS3, Xbox One/360/Series X S), streaming TV box, Sky Q Box, 4K Blu-ray player, DVD player, HDTV, soundbars, AV receiver, projector, monitor, display, video capture card, etc.
